notablePrerequisites: Opponents have at least five poison counters.
description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Phyrexian Swarmlord triggers, creating at least five 1/1 Phyrexian Insect creature tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five Phyrexian Infects, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
